data.tax_note: This is the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 itself; keep it for your records as it shows your deducted expenses (Werbungskosten, Sonderausgaben, außergewöhnliche Belastungen) and the resulting refund.
data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 (Einkommensteuerbescheid) – €713.00 refund
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterhöhe sent Bastian Musterquell the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025, dated 19 November 2026, resulting in a refund (Guthaben) of €713.00 to be transferred to his account. An objection (Einspruch) can be filed within one month of notification if he disagrees.
data.explanation: This letter is your official 2025 income tax result from the Finanzamt: it calculated €7,402.00 in tax against €8,115.00 already withheld from your wages, giving you a refund of €713.00, which will be transferred automatically — no action needed for that. If you think something in the calculation (e.g. deductible costs) is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt, in writing, via ELSTER, or orally to the record; the app shows the deadline. If you miss it, the assessment becomes final. Consider consulting a tax advisor (Steuerberater) if the figures seem incorrect.
